stem.text: Ammonia, $\text{NH}_3$, and hydrazine, $\text{NH}_2\text{NH}_2$, are two compounds of nitrogen, $\text{N}_2$.

B.text: $\text{NH}_3$ and $\text{NH}_2\text{NH}_2$ have lone pairs of electrons but $\text{N}_2$ does not.

C.text: The oxidation number of each nitrogen in $\text{NH}_2\text{NH}_2$ is +2.

D.text: The reaction of nitrogen with hydrogen has a high activation energy.
